history.summary: A small community Hindu temple at Tuivamit, Aizawl (MZU Road / Solomons Temple Road, PIN 796009), serving the small Hindu minority (Bengali traders, government and paramilitary families) in a city that is overwhelmingly Mizo Christian. It appears only in map listings (a Meta place entry at 23.745438, 92.682809 and a onefivenine directory listing) - no published history, founder, or construction date exists (UNVERIFIED). It is a modern shrine near the Mizoram University (MZU) area. Do not confuse with the larger ISKCON Temple at Chawlhhmun, Aizawl.

name: Shri Radha Krishna Temple
town_description: Aizawl is the capital of Mizoram, spread across steep hills at about 1,130 m altitude. Its population is overwhelmingly Mizo and Christian (roughly 87%); the small Hindu minority is mainly Bengali traders, central-government staff and paramilitary personnel, who maintain a handful of modest community temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport, approx. 35 km north of the city (verify).
travel.railway: Nearest railhead Sairang, approx. 20 km from the city (verify - new Bairabi-Sairang line).
travel.road: On MZU Road / Solomons Temple Road at Tuivamit; well connected by city buses and taxis (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather (verify).
